space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

query.description: Words, "a phrase", word*, +required, -excluded, and subject:, tags: or body: before a term. Terms are OR by default

project.description: A project label: its records and the records with no project

projectOnly.description: With project: only that project's records, not the records with no project

classes.description: Only these classes; default: every class

tags.description: Only records with every one of these tags

agent.description: Only records written by the agent with this id

mine.description: Only your own records; default: every record you can read

authorities.description: Only records with these authorities; how to pull what a session-start bundle left out

asOf.description: Read as of these instants, RFC 3339; each defaults to now

recorded.description: When the store believed them (recorded time)

includeExpired.description: Also return expired records not yet purged

format.description: detailed adds the text, tags, session, agent, confidence, constraints, sources, confirmation and observations
